title_sq: Ne Fresk, Shitet Apartament 1+1, Me Planimetri Te Rregullt!!

title_en: In Freske, 1+1 apartment for sale, with a regular floor plan!!
description_en: In Freske, 1+1 apartment for sale, with a regular floor plan!!! The property is located on the 4th floor, and has a gross area of ​​63 m2, of which the net area is 57 m2.
